note: Singles and EPs whose songs Apple Music lists on one of the artist's albums Dan played, so the shelf counts them on that album (Dan, 18 November 2026). Each was checked against the album's Apple track list; ids are public catalogue ids.

folds.evidence: Apple lists Victory Lap as track 18 of USB (2026).
